article.title: Why Naming a File Clearly Saves Time Later

paragraphs.en:
A file name looks like a small detail, but a clear name can save time every day. When people work quickly, they often create files called final.xlsx, new.docx, or report2.pptx. These names may make sense at that moment. A week later, however, nobody remembers which file is really final.

A useful file name answers a few simple questions. What is the file about? What date or period does it cover? Which version is it? For example, customer_rank_FY25_v03.xlsx is much clearer than final_new2.xlsx. If a team uses the same naming rule, everyone can understand the file without opening it.

Dates are especially useful for repeated work. Using a consistent format such as 2026-09-01 keeps files easy to sort. Version numbers also help during review. Instead of adding words such as final, latest, or really_final, use v01, v02, and v03. When a file is officially approved, the team can mark that state separately.

Clear names also reduce communication cost. A colleague can say, “Please review customer_rank_FY25_v03.xlsx,” instead of asking which attachment is the newest one. This lowers the chance that someone edits an old copy or sends the wrong version to a client.

A good rule should stay simple. If file names become extremely long, people will stop following the rule. Choose only the information that helps people identify, sort, and distinguish files.

Before saving your next file, imagine that you will open the folder three months later with no memory of today's work. Would the name still tell you what the file contains? If the answer is yes, the file name is doing its job.
paragraphs.zh: 檔名看似小事，卻會持續影響搜尋與協作效率。像 final.xlsx、new.docx 這類名稱當下看得懂，一週後卻很難知道哪個才是最新版。好的檔名應回答內容、日期或期間、版本等基本問題，例如 customer_rank_FY25_v03.xlsx。日期使用一致格式、版本使用 v01/v02 等規則，可以降低拿錯舊檔、寄錯附件與反覆確認的成本。規則也不宜過度複雜；只保留真正有助於識別、排序與區分檔案的資訊。存檔前可以想像三個月後完全忘記今天工作的自己，是否仍能只看檔名理解內容。
paragraphs.ja: ファイル名は小さなことに見えますが、検索や共同作業の効率に継続的に影響します。final.xlsx のような名前は作成時には分かっても、後から最新版を判断しにくくなります。内容、日付・対象期間、バージョンを一定のルールで含めると、古いファイルの編集や誤送付を減らせます。ルールは複雑にしすぎず、識別・並べ替え・区別に必要な情報だけを残すことが重要です。

vocabulary.usage: Identify a file without opening it.
